verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a shared SMS inbox through its Business SMS Booster, call queues for routing shared lines, call delegation, and a team messaging API. Together these support teammates sharing a number, but the evidence is marketing one-liners. Missing for 10: explicit presence or availability indicators for teammates, documented conversation assignment or ownership within the shared inbox, internal threads or notes attached to customer conversations, and in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.
